preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, 1, 0) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'healthmesh_ciel_preferred_backup'

changeSet.comment: Emergency restore of CIEL preferred flags from backup, only if the CIEL import failed after preferred flags were cleared. Do not include this file in normal startup.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept_name cn JOIN healthmesh_ciel_preferred_backup b ON b.concept_name_id = cn.concept_name_id SET cn.locale_preferred = b.locale_preferred WHERE b.backup_reason = 'Before clearing all existing CIEL preferred flags for OCL import 20260609-02';
